S4 IMPLEMENTATION PLAN COMPLETE (sprint Phase B full ceremony).

**Approach (approach-decision-maker opus)**: P1 — Umbrella job in ci.yml with bash scanner using 'git merge-tree --write-tree' for cumulative session-state scan. Score 21/25 vs P2 18/25 (drops umbrella mandate) vs P3 13/25 (Python dependency on merge-block path, fails Gate 3).

**Tasks created (7 total)**:
- T1 (d080-7fd3-1a19-4e85) RED — scan-red-markers.sh unit tests (5+1 GWT cases incl conflict markers) [no deps]
- T2 (5d71-bec7-f54f-4fc9) IMPL — plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh bash + git merge-tree + SHA pinning + conflict-marker handling (no fallback) [depends T1]
- T3 (2b99-ea45-ffda-498a) RED — behavioral two-sub-PR resurfacing test (3-commit fixture) [depends T2]
- T4 (a794-e908-6ae8-4516) IMPL — ci.yml NEW JOB (not step) + register required-checks.txt + override mechanism + SHA capture at job start [depends T3]
- T5 (4772-49c7-eacb-48e8) DOC — CI-INTEGRATION.md (5 sections: umbrella, merged-tree rationale, SHA-pinning, override, cutover handoff) [depends T4]
- T6 (sprint-fixture self-test) — short-lived RED marker on throwaway sub-branch + cleanup (DD#4 explicit) [depends T4]
- T7 (a8c4...parity) RED — scan-red-markers vs parse_test_index grammar parity test [depends T2]

**Plan-Review (dso:plan-review)**: REVISE_REQUESTED with 7 findings (1 critical, 4 major, 1 minor, 1 informational-resolved). Applied as AC amendments to T1 (conflict markers), T2 (no parse_test_index reuse, no fallback, SHA pinning, conflict-marker handling), T3 (3-commit fixture), T4 (job-level not step-level, SHA capture, override mechanism, S5 coordination), T5 (doc 5 sections).

**Gap-Analysis**: 7 findings — 2 NEW tasks (T6 sprint-fixture, T7 parity), 5 AC amendments folded into base tasks. State_file_conflict flag on T4 ↔ S5 ci.yml edits documented as a coordination constraint.
